# Barcode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders a supported one-dimensional barcode as vector graphics.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IAltTextProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Barcode(options?: BarcodeOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`altText`](#alttext): Alternate text description for accessibility.
- [`backgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Quiet-zone colour.
- [`drawBackground`](#drawbackground): Whether to draw the background.
- [`foregroundColor`](#foregroundcolor): Bar colour.
- [`gs1`](#gs1): Encode Code 128 with the GS1 start and field separators.
- [`height`](#height): Height of the bars in points (excludes the text label).
- [`includeTextLabel`](#includetextlabel): Whether to render the human-readable value beneath the bars.
- [`isDecorative`](#isdecorative): When `true`, the barcode is tagged as a decorative `/Artifact`.
- [`moduleWidth`](#modulewidth): Width of the narrowest bar (one module) in points.
- [`quietZone`](#quietzone): Number of quiet-zone modules on each side.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
- [`symbology`](#symbology): The barcode symbology.
- [`textLabelFontSize`](#textlabelfontsize): Font size of the human-readable text label, in points.
- [`value`](#value): The value to encode.

### `altText`

```typescript
altText: string
```

Alternate text description for accessibility. Populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element when the document opts into PDF/UA-1.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/barcodes`:

```typescript
barcode.altText = `${cardTitle}: ${value}`;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/patient-summary`:

```typescript
barcode.altText = 'Hospital number barcode: H0482931';
```

### `backgroundColor`

```typescript
backgroundColor: Color
```

Quiet-zone colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/patient-summary`:

```typescript
barcode.backgroundColor = Color.white;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/retail-events/event-ticket`:

```typescript
ticketBarcode.backgroundColor = CREAM;
```

### `drawBackground`

```typescript
drawBackground: boolean
```

Whether to draw the background. Default true.

### `foregroundColor`

```typescript
foregroundColor: Color
```

Bar colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/patient-summary`:

```typescript
barcode.foregroundColor = INK;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/retail-events/event-ticket`:

```typescript
ticketBarcode.foregroundColor = INK;
```

### `gs1`

```typescript
gs1: boolean
```

Encode Code 128 with the GS1 start and field separators.

### `height`

```typescript
height: number
```

Height of the bars in points (excludes the text label). Default 60.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'2cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `industry-templates/sales-supply-chain/shipping-label`:

```typescript
carton.height = 40;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/barcodes`:

```typescript
barcode.height = 55;
```

### `includeTextLabel`

```typescript
includeTextLabel: boolean
```

Whether to render the human-readable value beneath the bars. Default true.

Example, from `industry-templates/billing-payments/utility-bill`:

```typescript
barcode.includeTextLabel = true;
```

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative: boolean
```

When `true`, the barcode is tagged as a decorative `/Artifact`.

### `moduleWidth`

```typescript
moduleWidth: number
```

Width of the narrowest bar (one module) in points. Default 1.5.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'0.5mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/public-library-membership-letter`:

```typescript
barcode.moduleWidth = 1;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/billing-payments/utility-bill`:

```typescript
barcode.moduleWidth = 0.9;
```

### `quietZone`

```typescript
quietZone: number
```

Number of quiet-zone modules on each side. Negative means the per-symbology default.

### `semanticRole`

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. [`SemanticRole.H1`](semantic-role.md#h1), [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p), [`SemanticRole.Figure`](semantic-role.md#figure)).

### `symbology`

```typescript
symbology: BarcodeSymbology
```

The barcode symbology. Defaults to Code 128.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/barcodes`:

```typescript
barcode.symbology = symbology;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/sales-supply-chain/shipping-label`:

```typescript
carton.symbology = BarcodeSymbology.Itf14;
```

### `textLabelFontSize`

```typescript
textLabelFontSize: number
```

Font size of the human-readable text label, in points. Default 9.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'9pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `code-recipes/layout-flow/vertical-stack-overflow`:

```typescript
barcode.textLabelFontSize = 8;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/billing-payments/utility-bill`:

```typescript
barcode.textLabelFontSize = 6.5;
```

### `value`

```typescript
value: string
```

The value to encode. Content rules depend on `symbology`.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/barcodes`:

```typescript
barcode.value = value;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/layout-flow/vertical-stack-overflow`:

```typescript
barcode.value = location;
```
